title: Ep 44 — Grok's Cheaper-Per-Token Trap, and the App-Mockup Tool Built From Two Failed Products
description: xAI's Grok 4.7 ships with a lower per-token price but independent testing finds it can cost more per task once real token usage is counted, while GitHub Copilot adds the model same-day and Perplexity cuts AI-agent tool-call failures by over 21 percent. Plus a deep dive on Sleek, the AI mobile-app mockup generator that hit $10k MRR in six weeks — built largely from its founder's two earlier failed products — niched here as a live-pitch instant-mockup tool for PlayFundWin and LeaguePages, with the Fundraising Regulator and EV-Partnerships operator-gap threads both unchanged this week.
